title: Heat Pump
description: Clock-synced sidechain ducking: hold + log release
text:
Heat Pump is a clock-synced sidechain ducking envelope: on each division the CV ducks, holds briefly, then recovers with a logarithmic release. Patch CV Out to a filter or VCA; MIDI CC mirrors when Out is enabled.

Main sets release speed. Shift + fader sets depth. Button + fader picks clock division. Short tap triggers one manual duck. Long press mutes without snapping to idle. Shift + long toggles invert.

channels.jackDescription: CV Out = duck envelope; CV In modulates Depth, Release, or triggers Duck.

title: Grooves
description: Multi-genre MIDI drum grooves with feel
text: Grooves is a one-channel multi-genre drum helper with up to seven MIDI voices clock-synced in 4/4. **Groove** picks the genre family; **Density** and **Feel** shape fills and character; **Drummer** personas (long press) change ornament style. Swing depth is capped by **Swing max %** (sign = direction). Jack modes include Any/Stacked CV out and CV in for Density, Feel, or Reset. Clock-driven scheduling stays in a dedicated processor; MIDI sends run in a separate task (`pending_*` isolation).

channels.jackDescription: Any: velocity-weighted pulse per hit. Stacked: 1 V kick, 2 V snare, 4 V hats.
channels.faderDescription: Reveals extra drum hits as ghosts.
channels.fnPlusShiftDescription: Short: reverse swing. Long: Any vs Stacked.

title: Sift
text:
Sift is a two-channel sequencer built around stored threshold patterns. Channel 1 is the gate lane and Channel 2 is the CV lane. Both lanes have ten stored patterns that can be selected independently, making it easy to keep one rhythmic structure while changing the other.

Playback follows the shared 24 PPQN transport. Gate density is sampled only at step boundaries, so changing the fader during playback does not create off-clock triggers. When a gate step passes the threshold, the gate output fires and Sift can also emit a MIDI note derived from the current CV through Faderpunk's global quantizer.

The CV lane outputs stepped voltages. Its fader chooses the number of available CV levels from a musical set: 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 8, 12, 16, 24, or 32. The CV range, polarity, minimum and maximum voltage, step counts, clock division, gate length, color, MIDI channel, and MIDI output are set from the app parameters.

#### Pattern Banks

Each lane stores ten deterministic patterns. Hold Shift and move the gate or CV lane fader to choose the active pattern for that lane. The corresponding bottom LED flashes once when the selection changes.

* **Gate pattern select:** Shift + Fader 1
* **CV pattern select:** Shift + Fader 2
* **Randomize selected patterns:** Shift + Button 1
* **Randomize all patterns:** Shift + Button 2

#### Performance Notes

* Button 1 resets both sequencer positions to the next first step.
* Button 2 mutes gate and MIDI note output. Both button LEDs dim while muted; the CV lane keeps stepping.
* Notes are released with the gate, on reset, on stop, when muted, or when a scene is loaded.
* Scenes store the pattern bank seeds, selected pattern numbers, live fader values, and mute state.

channels.jackDescription: Gate output for steps passing the threshold
channels.faderDescription: Sets how many stored gate pattern values pass the threshold
channels.faderPlusShiftDescription: Selects one of the ten stored gate patterns
channels.fnDescription: Resets both lane positions to the next first step
channels.fnPlusShiftDescription: Randomizes the currently selected gate and CV patterns

channels.jackDescription: Stepped CV output using the configured range
channels.faderDescription: Selects the number of active CV levels: 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 8, 12, 16, 24, or 32
channels.faderPlusShiftDescription: Selects one of the ten stored CV patterns
channels.fnDescription: Mutes gate and MIDI note output; CV keeps stepping
channels.fnPlusShiftDescription: Randomizes every stored gate and CV pattern in the bank

storage: CV and gate pattern select faders
